title: Ramsey numbers and Gallai--Ramsey numbers of disjoint unions of cherries
summary: For graphs $G_1,\ldots,G_k$, the Ramsey number $R(G_1,\ldots,G_k)$ is the smallest positive integer $N$ such that every $k$-edge-coloring of $K_N$ contains a monochromatic copy of $G_i$ in color $i$ for some $i\in[k]$. The Gallai--Ramsey number $GR(G_1,\ldots,G_k)$ is defined analogously, with the colorings restricted to Gallai colorings (i.e., edge-colorings with no rainbow triangle).
